name: Bedrock Dedicated Server
description:
🌍✨ PxCraft Bedrock Server ✨🌍

Welcome to PxCraft, a friendly Bedrock Server built for people who love playing together. Whether you're starting a fresh adventure, building a base with friends, or just looking for a relaxed place to hang out, there's a spot for you here. Our world is always growing, and so is our community!

🛠️ Features

- 🤝🌐 TPA & Warps — fast travel to friends and key locations without the long walk.

- 🏠 Homes — save your favorite spots and return to them anytime.

- 👥 Parties & Teams — team up, share goals, and play together with friends.

- 🏪 Shop — buy and sell items to build your own economy.

- 🌟 Friendly Community — welcoming players and helpful staff who are always around.

💬 Our Community

We keep things fun, fair, and respectful. New players are always welcome, and our staff is happy to help you get started, answer questions, or hear your ideas.

🔓 Ready to join?

👉Join our Discord below and enter the world!

Discord: https://discord.gg/Xck3kKJuDg

See you in game! 🎮
